sources.title: MassGIS/MassDOT Roads FeatureServer - Medford extract
sources.notes: Built by build_medford_streets.py using MGIS_TOWN='MEDFORD' and GeoJSON output.

sources.title: Traffic Commission Regulations PDF (current edition)
sources.notes: Canonical legal source parsed by build_parking_rules.py. Fetch metadata records the resolved URL, Last-Modified, ETag, byte count, and SHA-256 before rules are rebuilt.

sources.title: Somerville Parking Department
sources.notes: Operational citywide parking guidance and the embedded municipal-lot map. The facility builder preserves this page and verifies the expected map is still published; it is not a replacement for the legal schedules.

sources.title: Somerville Parking Meters GIS
sources.notes: Official meter inventory whose data was last updated in 2017. Do not use it as current legal authority.

sources.title: Somerville Map of Municipal Parking Lots
sources.notes: Detailed lot map embedded by the current official Parking Department page. Preserve the KML and normalize its hours, capacity, accessible, EV, and special-restriction fields.

sources.title: Assembly Row Public Visitor Parking
sources.notes: Primary operator source for six public visitor garages and the Assembly Marketplace customer lot. These facilities are privately owned or managed, not Somerville municipal parking. Live detail pages are validated for current facility names, addresses, rates, and restrictions; clean visible-text snapshots and original response hashes are preserved without third-party scripts.

sources.title: Assembly Row Parking Map Markers
sources.notes: Operator map points for the seven facilities linked by the current Assembly Row parking index. The builder preserves only those seven selected marker records and validates them against the detail pages before publishing.

sources.title: Cambridge GIS Street Centerlines
sources.notes: Built by build_cambridge_data.py into the app street schema.

sources.title: Cambridge GIS Metered Parking Spaces
sources.notes: Built by build_cambridge_data.py. Meter polygons are also summarized in data/processed/cambridge/parking_rules.json by nearest street and retained as segment evidence, not whole-street classification.

sources.title: Cambridge GIS Public Handicap Parking Spaces
sources.notes: Built by build_cambridge_data.py. Accessible points are also summarized in data/processed/cambridge/parking_rules.json by street name.

sources.title: Cambridge GIS Municipal Parking Lots and Garages
sources.notes: The shared facility builder combines these 9 municipal lots and 2 municipal garages with Somerville municipal and operator-backed public-access facility sources.

sources.title: Cambridge Public Parking Lots and Garages
sources.notes: Current driver-facing lot and garage entrances, hours, prices, time limits, and EV guidance. The facility builder preserves and validates this page before publishing normalized rules.

sources.title: Cambridge Traffic Regulations and Schedules
sources.notes: Official schedule index with side/from/to rule tables. Revisions require freshness review before becoming authoritative curb records.

sources.title: Aggregated Street Occupancy Permits
sources.notes: Large historical Socrata dataset. A future ingestor must query only active/complete permits whose end date has not passed; never bulk-download it through the generic fetcher.

sources.title: Parking Department page

sources.title: Resident Permit Parking Streets

sources.title: Boston Curb Lab
sources.notes: The city describes an authoritative curb data standard and future public API. Do not depend on it until the API is publicly verifiable.
